entries.title: Acts 6:1
segments: ¶But in those days, the disciples multiplying in number, there arose a murmuring of the Hellenists against the Hebrews because their widows were overlooked in the daily ministration.

entries.title: Acts 6:2
segments: And the twelve, having called the multitude of the disciples to [them], said, It is not right that we, leaving the word of God, should serve tables.

entries.title: Acts 6:3
segments: Look out therefore, brethren, from among yourselves seven men, well reported of, full of [the] [Holy] Spirit and wisdom, whom we will establish over this business:

entries.title: Acts 6:4
segments: but *we* will give ourselves up to prayer and the ministry of the word.

entries.title: Acts 6:5
segments: And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and [the] Holy Spirit, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas, a proselyte of Antioch,

entries.title: Acts 6:6
segments: whom they set before the apostles; and, having prayed, they laid their hands on them.

entries.title: Acts 6:7
segments: And the word of God increased; and the number of the disciples in Jerusalem was very greatly multiplied, and a great crowd of the priests obeyed the faith.

entries.title: Acts 6:8
segments: ¶And Stephen, full of grace and power, wrought wonders and great signs among the people.

entries.title: Acts 6:9
segments: And there arose up certain of those of the synagogue called of freedmen, and of Cyrenians, and of Alexandrians, and of those of Cilicia and Asia, disputing with Stephen.

entries.title: Acts 6:10
segments: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the Spirit with which he spoke.

entries.title: Acts 6:11
segments: Then they suborned men, saying, We have heard him speaking blasphemous words against Moses and God.

entries.title: Acts 6:12
segments: And they roused the people, and the elders, and the scribes. And coming upon [him] they seized him and brought [him] to the council.

entries.title: Acts 6:13
segments: And they set false witnesses, saying, This man does not cease speaking words against the holy place and the law;

entries.title: Acts 6:14
segments: for we have heard him saying, This Jesus the Nazaraean shall destroy this place, and change the customs which Moses taught us.

entries.title: Acts 6:15
segments: And all who sat in the council, looking fixedly on him, saw his face as [the] face of an angel.
